name: Secure Streaming Orders Flex Template
description: Production streaming pipeline with Private IPs, CMEK encryption, and BigQuery Storage Write API.

parameters.name: input_subscription
parameters.label: Pub/Sub Input Subscription
parameters.helpText: The Pub/Sub subscription to read orders from (projects/<PROJECT>/subscriptions/<SUB>).

parameters.name: output_table
parameters.label: BigQuery Output Table
parameters.helpText: The BigQuery table to write curated orders to (<PROJECT>:<DATASET>.<TABLE>).

parameters.name: dataflow_kms_key
parameters.label: Customer Managed Encryption Key (CMEK)
parameters.helpText: Cloud KMS key resource ID for CMEK encryption.

parameters.name: subnetwork
parameters.label: VPC Subnetwork
parameters.helpText: VPC Subnetwork for private worker IP routing (https://www.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/.../subnetworks/...).
